arguments.code:
# Using previously fetched all_songs isn't persisted between tool calls? We'll refetch quickly and compute play counts.
# Step A: login and fetch all songs in library
pw=None
for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if x['account_name']=='spotify':
        pw=x['password']
        break
access_token=apis.spotify.login(username='glenn.burton@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']

all_songs=[]
i=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token,page_index=i,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_songs.extend(page)
    i+=1
print('total_songs',len(all_songs))

# Step B: get play_count for each song id
records=[]
for s in all_songs:
    song_id=s['song_id']
    details=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
    records.append({'song_id':song_id,'title':s['title'],'play_count':details.get('play_count',None)})

# Print for verification
print('play_counts',[(r['title'],r['play_count']) for r in records])

# Step C: find least-played (min play_count)
min_play=min(r['play_count'] for r in records)
least=[r for r in records if r['play_count']==min_play]
print('min_play',min_play,'least_count',len(least))
# Choose first occurrence in library order
least_first=least[0]
print('selected',least_first)
least_first['title']
